- Mobile contract "FunkNetz Smart M" with FunkNetz Mobil GmbH: cancel by Wed 14 Oct 2026, send by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2] [party:pty_gjsv4q2d3ajw].
- Energy contract "MusterStrom Flex" with Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH: a price increase takes effect Sun 1 Nov 2026; to cancel before it applies, cancel by Sat 31 Oct 2026 (send by Mon 26 Oct 2026, safe by Fri 30 Oct 2026) [contract:ctr_bbzemyapzvm5] [party:pty_fh8cf155ffm3].
